_about: Standard pronunciation benchmark (brief §8-9). Same inputs for every provider. Words tagged 'vn' are difficult sounds for Vietnamese speakers; 'ukus' differ between British and American English and must come out British.

sentences.text: My name is Yuki. I go to school every day. I like reading books and playing football with my friends.
I think that this is the third thing on the shelf.
The schedule says the tomato advertisement is in the garage.
Then the wind blows. Up goes the kite!

rubric_note: Score 1-5 per row by listening. Weight: pronunciation and british_authenticity x3, clarity x2, others x1. Naturalness never outranks accuracy for this project.
